name: Prepared high-level C calculator simulator

requirements: GCC or Clang with unsigned128-bit integer support

local_native_http.scope: Python transports requests to the compiled native C session; JavaScript draws returned pixels

static_webassembly.scope: Static deployment of the same high-level C engine compiled for browser execution; JavaScript transport/runtime glue is separate from C calculator arithmetic
static_webassembly.session_lifetime: Opaque C session in the page module; reload creates fresh memory

previous_deployment_verification.scope: Actual public HTTP delivery and desktop/mobile C-WASM UI proof; full firmware completeness remains false

api.input: ASCII expression; bounded4096 bytes excluding NUL
api.response: JSON, including native status, exact packed records, formatter tokens and framebuffer
api.encoder_failure: Invalid/unsupported ASCII is a separate encode-phase response; native arithmetic and radix admission remain evaluator policies
api.preans: ASCII PreAns is admitted only in COMP, matching native C8 override

implemented_interface_scope.evaluation: ASCII lowering into supported native-token prepared COMP/CMPLX/BASE-N expression grammar
implemented_interface_scope.power: ASCII powers are right-associative; native implicit power groups are closed explicitly
persistent_session_fields: ten scalar variable pairs including Ans
implemented_interface_scope.display: Prepared expression/result rendering at96x32,384 row-major packed framebuffer bytes; exact formatting follows mode and mathematical admission
implemented_interface_scope.plain_text: Best-effort transliteration of formatter-owned DISPLAY tokens, not numeric recomputation
implemented_interface_scope.browser: Expression editing, scientific insertions, mode/angle/output selectors, LCD drawing,20-entry page-local history, reset
implemented_interface_scope.history: Recalls expression and settings; re-evaluation uses current C calculator memory
implemented_interface_scope.http_sessions: Opaque C sessions keyed by cookie; one-hour inactivity expiry,64-session capacity with oldest-session eviction, all lost when server stops
implemented_interface_scope.python_transport: Standard-library HTTP and ctypes calls, no expression arithmetic
implemented_interface_scope.javascript_transport: Text editing, request transport and framebuffer drawing, no expression arithmetic

explicit_nonclaims: Full physical-key acquisition, timing or key-to-result pipeline parity
Retention of the complete native physical RAM image between requests
Every native expression or function is implemented
The100percent documented instruction-understanding metric proves full C completion
Plain-text transliteration replaces native pixel output

verification.scope: Exact token fixtures, syntax, output transaction, capacities, source/output overlap and bounded input

verification.release_scope: Versioned default fixture genuinely replayed after tool-path publication; historical private proof remains separate
verification.scope: Prepared original171F4/F12A/formatter/result-paint pipeline; independently written ASCII/native input pairs, records, state and LCD pixels
